title: Confirm alert will sometimes not snooze alert
symptom: Every now and then I can not confirm an alert and it reappears every minute. This happens as well with snooze from my pebble. I need to confirm it several times before it keeps quiet until the snooze time is done.
fix: The issue seems to be fixed after trying the latest nightly version, although it occurred once again during a 2-day test.
evidence_quote: The issue seems to be fixed. although it didn't occur on every alarm, I tried it for 2 days now and it happened once again.
